audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 and the 2+ item row both read 'Kennen', but the packet level chart says Skill for both, and the content prose already says level 1 is a mutual respect phase and that late game favours Urgot's percent-max-HP scaling.
audit.why: Urgot at level 1 has Corrosive Charge (Q, 800 range, 10s) as a ranged answer to Kennen's shuriken, and Purge (W) shreds a 550-range yordle who steps in. Late, Purge scales with Kennen's own HP build while Kennen's burst does not scale into a tanky Urgot.
audit.corrected: Level 1 = Skill, 2+ items = Skill, with matching win[] rows and why text.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate in shape: Kennen at 2-3 (second Q + Electrical Surge mark), level 6 Slicing Maelstrom, first-item Alternator/Rocketbelt, and Urgot scaling late. Urgot's own spike is Purge rank-ups (12/9/6/3/0s cooldown, free at rank 5) plus level 6 Fear Beyond Death at 100/85/70s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text repeatedly calls Urgot 'dash-less' and names his flip 'E (Corrosive Charge)'. Corrosive Charge is Q (the ranged explosive slow); Disdain is E — a charge with a shield that ends by hurling the first champion it catches. The missing-interaction file flags exactly this: Disdain's shield absorbs Kennen's burst window.
audit.why: Riot's own text: Q 'Fires an explosive charge at the target location... slowing enemies'; E 'Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself... he will stop and hurl them out of his way'. Disdain is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, so a baited Disdain leaves a 16s window at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Name Q as the slow and E (Disdain) as the shielded charge-flip; state that the shield eats Kennen's burst so it must be baited before committing R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown advice is vague ('track it before every engage') with no number.
audit.why: Disdain is 16s at rank 1; Fear Beyond Death is 100/85/70s.
audit.corrected: Give the 16s Disdain window and the 100s R as the concrete commit timers.

edits.before: Q-poke from range wins every melee matchup early. Identify how Urgot contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Trade Q pokes at range only: his Corrosive Charge (Q) answers back and Purge shreds you if you close, so bank chip, not commits.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Urgot carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items each: Purge's percent-max-HP scales into your build, so close it in a teamfight with R, never a sidelane duel.

edits.before: You out-range his immobile, dash-less kit — keep marking with Q from outside Purge and he can't trade back.
edits.after: You out-range him — mark with Q from outside Purge; his only step-up is Disdain (E), down 16s at rank 1.

edits.before: You hold a clear poke edge; just dodge his E (Corrosive Charge) so he can't slow you into Purge percent-HP range.
edits.after: You hold a clear poke edge; dodge his Q (Corrosive Charge) so its slow can't drag you into Purge percent-HP range.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom stun-locks an Urgot with no dash to leave the storm — Q-W-E-R bursts him before Purge ramps.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom stun-locks Urgot once Disdain (E) is spent — Q-W-E-R bursts him before Purge ramps up.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom into Q-W-E stun-lock blows up an Urgot who has no dash to leave your storm — your hardest all-in.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom into Q-W-E stun-lock blows up an Urgot who has spent Disdain (E) and cannot flip out of your storm.

edits.before: Land E (Corrosive Charge) to slow and flip you into Purge shotgun-leg range
edits.after: Land Q (Corrosive Charge), then flip you with Disdain (E) into Purge range

edits.before: This stretch is yours as long as you keep distance. Keep stacking Q marks and never walk into a W trade he can win with percent-HP. At 6, Slicing Maelstrom is the kill: he has no dash to walk out of your storm, so Q-W-E in, mark-stun lock, R, and he melts before his Purge ramps. Just track his R cooldown — eat his fear mid-channel and your all-in falls apart.
edits.after: This stretch is yours as long as you keep distance. Keep stacking Q marks and never walk into a W trade he can win with percent-HP. At 6, Slicing Maelstrom is the kill, but bait Disdain (E) first: it shields him and hurls you out. With it down 16s, Q-W-E in, mark-stun, R, and he melts. Track his R too — a fear mid-channel ends the all-in.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Disdain shields him and eats your burst — bait it, then commit inside 16s.

edits.before: Track Urgot's Disdain (Flip): His engage. E-dash/dodge it. When it is down — Stun-stack + R him.
edits.after: Disdain (E) shields him and hurls you: bait it, then for 16s stun-stack with Q/W and drop R on him.

notes: Fixed a slot swap repeated across the matchup: Corrosive Charge is Q (ranged slow), Disdain is E (shielded charge-flip). Level chart rows 0 and 6 flipped to Skill in both layers as one atomic group, matching the packet chart and the existing prose. Spell-shield/QSS/tenacity behaviour against Fear Beyond Death is not in the kit data and was not asserted.
